    ))
})

## What's seed hacking? 

<br>

::: {.fragment .nobullet}
Manually adjusting features in your analysis to cause the random variation that is due purely to differences in random seeding to appear to demonstrate a non-random effect in line with your hypothesis
:::

::: {.fragment .arrow-fragment-before .fragment-index-3}
Selecting a\ *hyper*\ specific seed: 
:::


<!-- To make sure coin_flip is loaded in the later cell block's namespace -->

```{webr}  
#| envir: coin_flip
#| autorun: true
#| echo: false
coin_flip <- function(num_flips){
    flips = sample(x=c("H", "T"), size=num_flips, replace=TRUE)
    heads = sum(flips=="H")
    print(
        glue::glue(
            "Number of heads from {num_flips} coin flips: {heads}"
            )
        )
    return(invisible(heads))
}
```



```{=html}
<div class='fragment fade-in'>
```
```{webr}
#| envir: coin_flip
set.seed(4623119)
coin_flip(num_flips=10)
```

## On repeating analyses

```{=html}
<div class='fragment fade-in'>
```
```{webr}
#| envir: coin_flip
set.seed(4623119)
coin_flip(num_flips=10)
coin_flip(num_flips=10)
```

```{=html}
</div>
```

:::{.fragment}
Better would 'ensembling', or running multiple seeds, using some 'average' metric
:::

:::{.fragment .subbullet}
What "average" means differs across analyses, not so easy as `mean(results)`
:::

:::{.fragment .subbullet}
ML: "bagging", voting, weight averaging. 
:::

:::{.fragment}
Cross Validation
:::

:::{.fragment .subbullet}
Training splits determined by seeding 
:::

## What about 42? 123? 875309?

```{=html}
<div class='fragment fade-in'>
```
```{r}
#| echo: true
read_data_transparently_published_on_osf <- function(identifier){
    project = osfr::osf_retrieve_node(paste0("https://osf.io/", identifier
    ,"/")) |> osfr::osf_ls_files()
    data_summary = osfr::osf_download(project, conflict="skip")
    df = read.csv(data_summary[["local_path"]]) 
    return(df)
}
```
```{html}
</div>
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
coin_flip <- function(n){
    return(sample(c(1,0), size=n, replace=TRUE))
}
```

<br>

```{=html}
<div class='fragment fade-in'>
```
```{r}
#| echo: true
# Without any dubiousness
library(dplyr)
set.seed(42)
data = read_data_transparently_published_on_osf("dw2rz")
glimpse(data)
```
```{html}
</div>
```

<br>

```{=html}
<div class='fragment fade-in'>
```
```{r}
predictions = coin_flip(nrow(data))
cat("Accuracy: ", mean(predictions == data$label), "\n")
```
